items.title: fzf-make: 0.37.0 -> 0.47.0

items.content_html:
Description of changes

Previously if the user enables this module but doesn't use the battery feature, the user can't enable upower (at least without lib.mkForce).

Minimal config to reproduce the issue this PR solves:

services.upower.enable = true;
services.dwm-status.enable = true;
services.dwm-status.order = [ ];
error: The option `services.upower.enable' has conflicting definition values:
- In `/nix/store/fz9xjls44cx9aqh16cw2j9li5jpzn8ky-source/system.nix': true
- In `/nix/store/wcidiyklj0nrljlz5m3qlkvhv8f2ddv8-source/nixos/modules/services/misc/dwm-status.nix': false
